title: Megurine Luka — Longing For The Sea〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Luka... Luka...!
Wake up, will you?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Luka, please wake up.
Tsukasa and the others are looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are they doing another show...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Their Little Mermaid show's all wrapped up now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Today, they're going to the beach!
They said that they want to have a little bit of fun before they have to head back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And Nene was wondering if you wanted to come along.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I won't let you leave her hanging like this, so go♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. As much as I'd like to keep sleeping, I suppose it'd be rude not to go...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great. Have fun, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Are you two not coming?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're busy preparing for a show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So bring back some good stories, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I will...
Swimming Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nene? Hello, is anybody there?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Good morning to you too, Nene, Rui. I heard you're headed for the beach. Thank you for inviting me.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hm? Are Emu and Tsukasa not with you?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu yelled something about having the beach all to herself and ran off. Tsukasa chased after her while telling her not to make such a big racket.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. As energetic as ever, I see.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know, right? Honestly, where does all their energy... *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you still sleepy, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't usually wake up this early...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What about you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm still sleepy too... But...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The others were kind enough to wake me up and give me a chance to enjoy the serene beauty of the sea. I feel compelled to stay awake.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. The way sunlight reflects off the surface of the water makes it look like there are countless stars beneath the waves.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Not only that...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The sound of the waves gently caressing the beach is very soothing.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You went out of your way to visit me yesterday, but that was at night and the beach was pitch black.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So I wanted to show you just how pretty this place is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Nene.
I appreciate your thoughtfulness.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Your performance yesterday was so much fun too. I'll be sure to cherish that memory.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you got to see it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I did. Actually, KAITO and MEIKO were there with me as we watched in secret.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The original Little Mermaid story is certainly a good one, but it has such a sad ending...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But the happy and fun version of the Little Mermaid that you and your friends came up with was so wonderful too.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'm so glad that it went as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It really is fun...
Doing shows with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I understand exactly how you feel. Performing on stage with MEIKO and the others is just so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wah...!
E-Emu...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You still seemed sleepy, but how about now? Are you awake, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, I'm definitely awake now, but I thought my heart was gonna stop too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't mean that at all, do you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Emu, Tsukasa, welcome back.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Luka!
Good morning♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent, you're awake.
We'll need to find a way to include her so that she can have fun too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Have fun? Does that involve going in the water?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, more along the lines of beach volleyball. Emu said she brought a ball along.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's one of those really squishy ones too, so it won't hurt at all! Wanna play?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I even made a court for us♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, wow... You did all this for us...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Beach volleyball sounds like a wonderful idea. I can't wait to see what happens.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you mind being the referee, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could do it ourselves, but having you referee for us seems fairest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, but... Are you sure about that?
What if she falls asleep during the match?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No need to worry. If I do start dozing off, I'll just referee while I'm asleep.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While you're asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll just have to cross that bridge when we get there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So we're going ahead with it regardless...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also, why beach volleyball?
Those two are like professional athletes compares to us. There's no way we can beat them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Luck of the draw, I suppose.
We'll just have to do our best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'd rather not get all sandy, so maybe I'll just sit this one out...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But this might end up becoming such a wonderful memory.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess you're right.
I'll give it a try, but just for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Great. We should all try to have as much fun as we can♪>
